summary.headline: Coforge's governance call: two directors resigned over a board-evaluation reporting gap; FY27 guidance kept at 20.5–21% EBITDA margin.
summary.overview: This was a special investor call, not a standard results call, convened by the full seven-member Board after the resignations of the former Chairman (September 8, 2026) and the former NRC chair (September 10, 2026). The internal auditor (KPMG) found that Board evaluation reports were shared only with the NRC chair and Chairman, and that the Chairman's lowest-rated category was not disclosed to the Board. Management said the matter has no bearing on operations or financials and reiterated FY27 guidance. Management also said Q2 is on track to be a record quarter for large deal signings, with a Global Investor Analyst Seminar planned for September 17. No Q1 FY27 financial figures were presented on the call.
guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance intact: consolidated EBITDA margin 20.5% to 21%, EBIT margin at least 15.5%, FCF conversion above 100% of PAT.
Four-year guidance of close to USD 5 billion unchanged; CFO said there is no change in any outlook stated so far.
Management said Q2 FY27 is likely to be the highest number of large deals signed in company history, and that the quarter is tracking to plan with two weeks left.
Management said it might sign as many large deals in Q2 alone as it signed in the full year two to three years earlier.
demand_pricing: Management described AI-driven demand as creating new, supply-constrained demand pools that favour focused firms.
Management said the cloud engineering practice is doing exceptionally well.

Management pointed to Nuuron (its AI operating system), Momentuum Blue (Forward Deployed Engineer Academy), Mod Squads (agent-human hybrids) and an open-weight, open-source practice as topics for the September 17 seminar.

qa_highlights.question: Has the Board evaluation report (BER) audit been deemed complete, and were others questioned besides the two departed directors?
qa_highlights.answer: Anil Chanana said the BER matter is fully covered by KPMG with no other observations; remaining audit areas are still in progress, and none should concern Board members.

qa_highlights.question: What is the fallback if the two new Independent Directors and chair are not found within about four months, and are they connected to other shareholders?
qa_highlights.answer: Vivek Sharma said Egon Zehnder is engaged, there is significant interest from India and global candidates, and he excluded himself from chair consideration; Beth Boucher said Vivek's appointment followed an 11-month search with 21 candidates and eight shortlisted, and the NRC concluded he met independence requirements, with over 83% shareholder support.

qa_highlights.question: Will the chair be independent or executive?
qa_highlights.answer: Vivek Sharma said only the Independent Directors other than himself will be considered as internal chair candidates; Sudhir Singh said the Executive Directors will not stand.

qa_highlights.question: Will the new internal audit areas (hire-to-retire, Board reporting) recur?
qa_highlights.answer: Anil Chanana said there is no commitment to repeat the audit; it was done for the first time and may be repeated after a couple of years depending on risk. New areas added include AI governance and third-party subcontractor risk.

qa_highlights.question: Is a third-party review planned of the events?
qa_highlights.answer: Anil Chanana said no further external review is needed because the matter arose from an external internal audit.

qa_highlights.question: Was there dissent on the Encora acquisition?
qa_highlights.answer: Sudhir Singh and Beth Boucher said decisions, including Encora, were unanimous after rigorous debate; Anil Chanana cited Cigniti's integration track record as support.

qa_highlights.question: Does Vivek Sharma's role as an AI advisor to Advent affect his independence?
qa_highlights.answer: Vivek Sharma said he is an advisor to multiple CEOs and companies, that his role changes over time, and that he is a fiduciary to Coforge with duties of loyalty and care.

qa_highlights.question: Is the NRC properly constituted with independent members?
qa_highlights.answer: Sudhir Singh said the NRC has four members, three of them independent, chaired by Beth Boucher, with Anil Chanana and Vivek Sharma added after reconstitution.

risks_watch: Permanent Chairperson and two new Independent Directors not yet appointed; timeline is open-ended and the interim chair term runs to January 31, 2027.
Board composition: only three of seven directors are independent, and the Board says further skill-based refresh may follow.
Whether further findings emerge from remaining KPMG audit areas (hire-to-retire, governance, AI governance), though management says these do not concern Board members.
Investor perception of independence, including questions on Vivek Sharma's outside advisory role.
Confirmation of Q2 FY27 large-deal signings and whether guidance is maintained at the next results release.
summary.management_tone: Defensive and emphatic on governance and guidance, with management repeatedly stating that the matter has no impact on operations or financials. Answers on Board independence and process were detailed but several were deferred (candidate profiles, chair selection timing), so some questions remained open.
key_quotes: Our near- term, medium-term, and long-term outlook remains unchanged and our FY2027 guidance remains intact.

We continue to expect a consolidated EBITDA margin of 20.5% to 21% for FY 2027, a consolidated EBIT margin of at least 15.5%, and a free cash flow conversion of above 100% of PAT in the current financial year.
I would also like to highlight that these matters have got nothing to do or have no impact on the Company's operations and/ or its financials.
